name: comm
summary: Compare two sorted files line by line.
description: Produces three columns for lines unique to the first file, unique to the second, and common to both.

examples.title: Show all comparison columns
examples.explanation: Displays unique-first, unique-second, and common lines as columns.

examples.title: Find additions
examples.explanation: Suppresses columns to show lines only in the new file.

examples.title: Find lines removed
examples.explanation: Shows entries present only in the old file.
